data.title: Verdana 3
data.about:
Verdana Townhouses new phase is in Dubai Investments Park (DIP), which offers contemporary high-end residential apartments, delivering the whole luxury lifestyle with close proximity to most of Dubai’s attractions, and is surrounded by parks, schools, mosques, and community retails. Verdana Townhouses Phase 3 at DIP is the latest residential series by Reportage Properties featuring limited entries of studio to 2 bedroom apartments and 2 to 5 bedroom luxury townhouses. This beautifully designed new phase introduces a limited collection of 131 meticulously designed residential facades, offering a harmonious blend of comfort and sophistication.

The DIP community is intended to be one of the region’s most environmentally friendly developments. Extensive landscaping and environmentally friendly policies emphasize the company’s commitment to a green, clean environment. Verdana 3 Dubai contains 131 Townhouses with Amenities that are easily accessible. In terms of design, quality, and space, they have all been built to the highest international standards.
